description: This file defines the ContainerRuntimeLoader class, which implements lazy loading of Twig runtime implementations from a PSR-11 container. It provides a constructor to inject the container and a load method to retrieve services by class name.

classes.name: Twig\RuntimeLoader\ContainerRuntimeLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for lazy loading Twig runtime implementations from a PSR-11 container.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a Twig runtime implementation by class name from the container.
